summary: This clinical trial is studying how certain medications affect blood sugar and ketone production in people with Type 2 Diabetes. The study tests drugs named empagliflozin and pioglitazone to see how they work in the body. It is currently Recruiting a target of 64 participants. The sponsor for this research is The University of Texas Health Science Center at San Antonio.
